description: This file defines the 'Router' class, which manages routing, caching, fallback mechanisms, and endpoint initialization for a large language model (LLM) API platform. It includes methods for handling completions, stream handling, fallback strategies, and integration with various services such as vector stores, OCR, videos, containers, and external APIs like Google GenAI. The class supports multiple routing strategies (least busy, latency-based, cost-based, etc.), manages deployment validation, and maintains metrics for load balancing and performance monitoring.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: This class manages the routing, caching, fallback logic, and endpoint initialization for a multilingual LLM platform. It supports multiple routing strategies, fallback mechanisms, and integrates with various external services. Key functionalities include handling prompt completions (sync and async), stream processing, deployment validation, metrics tracking, and flexible endpoint configuration.
